summary: SunCar Technology Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that its board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $10 million of outstanding Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001. No price per share, premium, or fixed expiration beyond an expected three-month duration was stated. Repurchases may occur on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions under Rules 10b5-1 and 10b-18, funded by cash on hand and operations; timing and volume depend on regulatory limits and market conditions. Watch execution pace relative to the $10M cap and any signal on management's valuation view.
